name: 1 Corinthians
tagline: Order and love in a divided church
author: The apostle Paul.
setting: Written to the church in Corinth, which faced division and moral problems.
theme: The cross reshapes church life, and love is the way of Christ’s people.

outline.label: Order in worship and the Lord’s Supper

christInBook: Paul says that Christ crucified is the power and wisdom of God (1:23-24), that Christ is our Passover lamb (5:7), and that he has been raised as the firstfruits of those who have died (15:20).
howToRead: 1 Corinthians answers specific questions and problems in a divided church. Notice how Paul returns to the cross in each section, and how chapter 13 on love sits in the middle of the discussion of gifts.
